root_cause.text: In the iommupt unmap_pages operation, when a large or contiguous IOPTE is partially unmapped the function unmaps the entire entry (more than requested), but the TLB gather range was computed using the requested size (`len`) instead of the actual unmapped size (`unmap.unmapped`), causing incomplete TLB invalidation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `gather_range_pages(iotlb_gather, iommu_table, iova, len, &unmap.free_list)` to `gather_range_pages(iotlb_gather, iommu_table, iova, unmap.unmapped, &unmap.free_list)`, and the commit message explicitly states: "unmap has the odd behavior that it can unmap more than requested if the ending point lands within the middle of a large or contiguous IOPTE. ... The gather was only flushing the range requested to be unmapped, not extending to the extra range, resulting in a short invalidation."
